# MotionGrid Technologies

> MotionGrid Technologies is a South African bespoke software agency. We design, build, and maintain custom software platforms — from client portals and field-service tools to applied AI features — engineered for precision, performance, and longevity.

## About

MotionGrid Technologies Pty(ltd) is a software development agency based in Johannesburg, South Africa. We build tailor-made platforms that automate workflows, connect teams, and scale with growing businesses. Every platform is engineered around the actual workflow it needs to carry — not templated.

We are a two-founder studio:
- **Prince Ncube** — Co-Founder & Engineering Lead. Systems architecture, backend, and infrastructure.
- **Mnqobi Ntuli** — Co-Founder & Product Lead. Product and interface design, client delivery.

## What we do

- **Custom software platforms** — client portals, operations tooling, and workflow automation built around your actual process.
- **Field-service & workshop tooling** — job scheduling, quoting, job cards, technician workflows, and vehicle-lifecycle tracking.
- **Applied AI** — document processing, predictive scheduling, and AI features layered into existing products.
- **Web platforms & e-commerce operations** — inventory, point-of-sale, and logistics tooling.

## Industries we serve

- Plumbing — field service and dispatch tooling for contractors.
- Fleet Maintenance — maintenance scheduling, inspection logs, and vehicle-lifecycle tracking.
- Panel Beating — estimate-to-handover workflows for panel and body shops.
- Artificial Intelligence — applied AI features and automation in existing products.
- Logistics — route planning and delivery operations tooling.
- Healthcare — practice and clinic workflow software.
- Retail — inventory, point-of-sale, and operations tooling.

## Technology

- **Frontend:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend & data:** Supabase, PostgreSQL, Node.js.
- **Infrastructure:** Vercel, Supabase.
- **AI:** machine learning, document processing, predictive scheduling.

## How we work

- No intake queue or account manager — every enquiry reaches a founder directly.
- We give honest recommendations on whether software is the right fix for a problem.
- Clear project handover from first conversation through delivery.
